decision_status: The CONDITIONAL GO recorded here was FALSIFIED on 2026-08-02 by the first real shard execution (Gate 4). The full-corpus preparation path had never produced trainer-consumable data: the container was handed Parquet shard manifests it cannot read, and line images were never extracted. No prepared run could have trained. Root cause fixed in commit cbf9b21 and verified through the real container interface; a re-decision follows once a run is prepared with the fix in place. See gate4_first_shard_review_record.md and risk R-023.

gate4_first_shard_result.safety_behaviour: all correct -- stopped cleanly at a shard boundary, status recorded honestly as failed

standing_lesson: Every verification before Gate 4 either used known-good pilot data or stopped before the trainer. Shard CONTENTS were verified exhaustively; shard FORMAT never was. No readiness decision should be issued again until real artifacts have been fed to the real trainer interface at least once.
